To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the traditional knowledge pyramid is being replaced with an analytics pyramid in which time is the pinnacle of knowledge.
the pursuit of Knowledge is an interactive/repetitive movement through the Analytics Pyramid and that the wisdom gained from Analytics is only recognized in a longitudinal manner.
analytics is a pursuit of wisdom that is gained by adapting through the analytics pyramid.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the pursuit of knowledge through analytics.
how organizations use analytics to gain knowledge and wisdom in a changing business environment.
the adaptation of the Knowledge pyramid to the Analytics Pyramid and the importance of the Time aspect of the Analytics Pyramid in the pursuit of knowledge.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
analytics is a tool for pursuing knowledge, but it is not knowledge.
analytics in pursuit of knowledge is a never-ending cycle of description, aggregation, modeling, and time.
the Analytics Pyramid provides a framework to guide the pursuit of knowledge and to provide an understanding of the interrelationship of the DIKW and the Analytics Pyramid.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Analytics Pyramid is a more accurate representation of the pursuit of knowledge than the traditional Knowledge Pyramid.
the Analytics Pyramid provides a framework for organizations to adapt to changing environments and to pursue wisdom in the pursuit of knowledge.
analytics in the pursuit of knowledge requires an iterative/repetitive movement through all Description-AggregationModeling-Time stages to achieve the pinnacle Wisdom of the Analytics Pyramid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
organizations must adapt to the ever changing environment in order to gain the wisdom that is sought in the pursuit of knowledge.
organizations should not focus on the traditional Knowledge Pyramid but instead focus on the Analytics Pyramid.
the Analytics Pyramid can be used to help organizations understand the importance of adaptiveness in their pursuit of knowledge.
